what: Johnson & Johnson is a healthcare group focused on prescription medicines (Innovative Medicine) and medical devices (MedTech) after spinning off its consumer brands as Kenvue in 2023.
customers: Patients through doctors and hospitals, insurers and governments that pay for treatment, and surgeons who use its devices.
money: drugs for cancer (Darzalex, Carvykti), immunology (Stelara, Tremfya) and neuroscience
surgical tools, orthopedics, heart devices and contact lenses
moat: A broad portfolio of patented drugs, deep relationships with hospitals and surgeons, and a AAA-rated balance sheet.
risks: Patent expiry of Stelara and biosimilar competition
